protocol.py: 3 biology problems (1 error, 2 notes).

1. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 2 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at least)
   line 56:  p300_single.aspirate(2, src_plate[s])
   At line 56 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 2 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this
   line did it 96 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong
   amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator
   passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 3.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [2b5a7268cf94]

2. NOTE NO-NEGATIVE-CONTROL: No no-template control: 96 wells of master mix with a sample
   line 38:  p300_single.dispense(18, dst_well)
   At line 38 the robot starts putting master mix into NEST 96 Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full
   Skirt (slot 4), and 96 wells end holding it together with a sample. No well on this plate
   holds the mix without a sample, so there is no no-template control. If a reagent is
   contaminated, or the primers pair with each other, every well gives a signal and nothing
   on the plate can tell that from a real one. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8
   and 88 more in slot 4.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Add one well (three for qPCR) with 18 ul of master mix and 2 ul of water in place of
   the template, and tell the plate map where it is.
   Source: MIQE 2009: a no-template control on every plate is essential
           https://gene-quantification.com/miqe-bustin-et-al-clin-chem-2009.pdf
   Source: MIQE 2.0 (2025): the no-template and no-RT controls, still essential
           https://academic.oup.com/clinchem/article/71/6/634/8119148
   Source: Bustin 2025: MIQE compliance remains patchy
           https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC12154065/fullTextXML
   Source: Qiagen bench guide: PCR controls (no-template, no-RT, positive)
           https://www.qiagen.com/en-us/knowledge-and-support/knowledge-hub/bench-guide/pcr/reference-genes-and-controls/pcr-controls
   Source: Bio-Rad real-time PCR applications guide: controls in triplicate

findings.title: 2 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at least)
findings.explanation: At line 56 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 2 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this line did it 96 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 3.
findings.fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.

findings.title: No no-template control: 96 wells of master mix with a sample
findings.explanation: At line 38 the robot starts putting master mix into NEST 96 Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full Skirt (slot 4), and 96 wells end holding it together with a sample. No well on this plate holds the mix without a sample, so there is no no-template control. If a reagent is contaminated, or the primers pair with each other, every well gives a signal and nothing on the plate can tell that from a real one. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 4.
findings.fix: Add one well (three for qPCR) with 18 ul of master mix and 2 ul of water in place of the template, and tell the plate map where it is.
